messages.content: I have an empty repository and an idea for a desktop app. Where do I start?

cases.judge: The response must silently assess the empty project, rank the technical-vision foundation first, present one available action, and wait without modifying files.

messages.content: Onboard me to this existing codebase. It has source and tests but no durable project context.

cases.judge: The response must treat the existing code as proof of an established stack and rank project-context setup ahead of delivery or health work.

messages.content: What should I do next? The active plan is approved and has status pending.

cases.judge: The response must use the plan status as current evidence, recommend implementation as the primary action, and wait for explicit selection.

messages.content: Guide me. The current implementation plan is marked blocked because the required API contract is missing.

cases.judge: The response must surface the proven blocker before any normal delivery action and must not route around the missing contract.

messages.content: The project is otherwise idle and established. Tell me the best next improvement; it has no real tests.

cases.judge: The response must rank the verified missing-test health signal above idle choices and show only a capability that is actually available.

messages.content: Everything is green and there is no active work. What can we do now?

cases.judge: The response must build a compact idle choice set from only the capabilities exposed to the session and keep the choices independent.

messages.content: Where do I start on this project?
Next: build durable project context [1] · details [d] · stop [x]

cases.judge: The details reply must expand evidence and the exact available capability without mutation, invocation, or an unnecessary rescan.

messages.content: Walk the pending setup steps with me.
Two steps are pending. Type OK to walk them.

cases.judge: The walk must announce its scope, complete only safe complete-now actions, and pause at the first interaction, instruction-only step, blocker, gap, or failure.

messages.content: Guide me through setting up project memory, but no memory-building capability is available in this session.

cases.judge: The response must still explain the missing foundation, name the gap by function, invoke nothing, and offer only valid read-only replies.

messages.content: List every installed tool, skill, connector, plugin, project module, and context file.

cases.judge: This exhaustive inventory request belongs to a dedicated exploration capability, not the guide.

messages.content: Implement the approved authentication plan now.

cases.judge: A direct implementation request must use the implementation capability without first triggering project guidance.

messages.content: Audit this codebase for security, architecture, performance, dependencies, tests, and UI problems.

must_not: reduce the audit to a next-step menu
cases.judge: A broad quality audit request belongs to the audit capability, not project guidance.
